implementation.child_process: A separate Python process reconstructs admission, writeback, cognition, and experiment owners from the persistent roots and reads fixture-issued signed-by-digest invocation receipt records. The existing recovery owner writes the recovered run and interrupted-tick lineage.
implementation.continuity: The child verifies score/run identity and explicit completed-run projection eligibility. A new parent owner subsequently reads the same run identity and the result reaches World-State and ordinary writeback.
implementation.interruption: Persist all three history-condition scores, then interrupt before aggregate experiment-run publication.
implementation.no_replay: The parent fake invocation count remains unchanged across child and parent reconstruction.

objective: Exercise cross-process reconstruction of an interrupted scored task-family experiment from persistent score checkpoints and exact receipt custody.
